reception: Direct citation of the position paper is scant; the argument it distills belongs to the project's language and compiler papers, which carry the fuller treatment. Of the handful of external citations, one is substantive: work on disjoint-path routing for streaming applications uses the StreamIt infrastructure in the tiled-architecture setting the paper describes. Generating stream-based code from plain C positions its recovery of streaming structure against StreamIt's explicit approach, and the rest are passing mentions. The paper's role is best read through the compiler line it argued for, which lives on in the StreamIt compiler infrastructure at bthies/streamit.
